observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon DSLR body with a lens mount area visible; the front text on the body appears to read D7000.
Photo 0 shows a red/black strap and a black body with some wear/scuffs.
Photo 1 shows the same Nikon DSLR body from a different angle; the lens cap is not on the lens mount in this shot.
Photo 1 shows a large cardboard box behind the camera with Nikon branding/markings; the box looks worn/taped.

claims.claim: The camera is working perfectly fine.
claims.evidence: No photo/video shows the camera powered on, shooting, autofocus, or error-free operation.

claims.claim: I am selling with 2 batteries and a silicone case.
claims.evidence: Photos show the camera body and a box, but no batteries or silicone case are clearly shown.

risks.risk: Shutter count/usage level and internal wear (common for DSLRs) not visible; could affect value and reliability.
risks.proof: A photo of the camera’s in-menu info showing shutter count/total actuations (or a screen showing shutter count) with the camera powered on.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used Nikon D7000 with unknown wear (worst-case reliability), not assuming low shutter count.

risks.risk: Camera may have faults (won’t power properly, battery door issues, button/joystick faults, sensor/mirror issues).
risks.proof: Short video: power on → menu screen visible → take a photo → playback shows a captured image; also show no error messages.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst-case) until a power-on + shooting proof is provided.

risks.risk: Battery quantity/condition may be less than claimed (or batteries may be weak/defective).
risks.proof: Photo of both batteries labeled/visible (and charger if any), plus a shot showing the camera running on each battery.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming only the camera body is confirmed, and accessories are not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Lens/accessories not shown; buyer may receive body only (no lens) or missing key parts.
risks.proof: Photo showing exactly what’s included laid out: body, lens (if any), batteries, charger, silicone case, and any cables/straps.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as body-only with unknown included accessories.

risks.risk: Box condition and markings don’t confirm authenticity or completeness; could be mismatched packaging.
risks.proof: Photo of the camera serial number label (and matching box label if present).

proof_requests: Power-on proof: clear photo/video of the Nikon D7000 menu screen with no error messages.
Shooting proof: take 1–3 photos and show playback (sharpness not required, just successful capture).
Show included items: lay out and photograph the 2 batteries and the silicone case (and charger if included).
Photo of shutter count/total actuations from the camera menu (or a shutter count app screen).
Photo of serial number label on the camera (and box label if available).
response.reason: The camera model (Nikon D7000) is readable from the photos, but the key claims—working perfectly fine and inclusion of 2 batteries + silicone case—are not verifiable from the images. Without power-on/shooting proof and a clear accessories shot, a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
